name: ai-dev-monitor
description: Live 3D view (Neural / Galaxy) of what Claude Code is doing in your project.

aiDevMonitor.port.description: Port of the local monitor server. The Claude Code hooks send events to this port.

enumDescriptions: Lightest: no anti-aliasing, 30 fps (10 when idle). Best for older laptops or battery.
Full resolution on high-DPI screens. Needs a good GPU.
aiDevMonitor.quality.description: Render quality of the 3D view. Reopen the panel after changing it.

aiDevMonitor.autoOpen.description: Open the monitor panel automatically when a Claude Code session starts in this window's workspace. The panel opens beside the editor without taking focus.

aiDevMonitor.autoStart.description: Start the monitor server when VS Code starts, so events are captured even while the panel is closed.
